title: iQOO Z11 Lite Launched in India with High Capacity Battery
summary: iQOO launched the Z11 Lite in India, a budget smartphone focused on long battery life with a 6500mAh cell, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, up to 6GB RAM plus 6GB virtual RAM and up to 1TB expandable storage. It runs OriginOS 6 on Android 16 and includes AI features, a 50MP main camera, IP65 protection and a bright display, with sales starting July 30 and early-buyer discounts.
content:
iQOO has officially introduced the iQOO Z11 Lite in India, positioning the device as a budget-friendly phone aimed at users who prioritise long battery life and reliable day-to-day performance. The headline feature is a large 6500mAh battery intended to keep users powered through extended workdays and travel.

Under the hood the Z11 Lite is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300, built on a 6nm process node. The phone offers up to 6GB of LPDDR4x RAM and includes an additional 6GB of virtual RAM for smoother multitasking. Storage is expandable and supports up to 1TB, giving users ample space for apps, media and files.

Software comes as OriginOS 6 based on Android 16. iQOO has committed to two major OS upgrades and four years of security updates for the 6GB RAM variant, a promise aimed at extending the device's usable life and delivering ongoing improvements.

iQOO highlights a suite of advanced AI features branded as the "Non-Stop Intelligence" software package, bringing optimisations and capabilities often seen on higher-tier models. Camera hardware consists of a dual rear setup led by a 50MP primary sensor, sourced either from the Sony IMX852 or the LYT505C depending on production batch, accompanied by a 0.08MP depth sensor. A 5MP front-facing camera sits in a waterdrop notch for selfies and video calls.

The Z11 Lite will be available in Midnight Blue and Solar Flame finishes. Retail sales begin on July 30 through Amazon India, the iQOO India online store and authorised physical retailers. iQOO is offering an early-purchase discount of ₹1,500 via card promotions on its store and Amazon; ICICI and HDFC cards are supported on the iQOO store and Axis and SBI card offers apply on Amazon. A three-month no-cost EMI option is also being promoted.

Other notable features include a display capable of 1200 nits peak brightness and IP65-rated water and dust resistance. While the screen resolution is 720p, the combination of a very large battery, AI-driven enhancements and a solid 50MP main camera positions the Z11 Lite as a competitive choice for gig workers and budget-conscious buyers who need dependable endurance and practical features.
